title: Gone Back to Work
summary: Whoever lit the Forgehall woke Oruth the Forgemaster, the clans' own ancestor, and he's forging for them as he was ordered to. Mother Coke wants him put back to sleep.

steps.journal: East on the Ashwater, below the Solmere road: the Forgehall of Oruth. Down to the deep forges, the second floor, and Oruth's own anvil.

ready: Oruth lay down at his anvil and went back to sleep. Tell Mother Coke in Ashgate.
done: Mother Coke sang the fortieth verse over him, and it rhymed again.
